description: A JUnit test class for the CredentialsApiAuthProvider in the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth.device package, testing authentication and credentials validation behavior.

classes.name: CredentialsApiAuthProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CredentialsApiAuthProvider, testing authentication failure scenarios, credential validation, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the provider instance before each test.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsWithExceptionReportedByCredentialsClient
methods.description: Verifies that the provider correctly propagates exceptions from the credentials client during authentication.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsWith401ForMalformedCredentials
methods.description: Checks that malformed credentials that lack required fields cause a 401 Unauthorized error.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsWith401ForNonExistingAuthId
methods.description: Ensures that an unknown auth ID results in a 401 Unauthorized error.

methods.name: testValidateFailsIfCredentialsAreDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that disabled credentials cause authentication to fail with a 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Helper to instantiate the CredentialsApiAuthProvider with mock behavior for testing.

methods.name: getDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Creates a mock device credentials object with specified parameters.

methods.name: getCredentialsObject
methods.description: Creates a mock CredentialsObject with specified parameters.
